about: A second labelled set for #24, written without looking at src/lib/rules.ts, with different wording and traps (exam/fee/registration in mail that isn't urgent). Same conventions as labelled.json: open registrations that a first-year can join are Urgent; admissions, other batches and newsletters are Later. Student: 26BCE (first year). Don't tune the rules to single cases here; fix the general pattern.
